events.name: Monster Jam
events.info: Get ready for the ultimate family day out! With awesome trucks, amazing stunts and action-packed excitement, Monster Jam® is the definition of fun for everyone! You'll be close to the action watching the world's best drivers tear up the dirt and show off crazy skills and all-out racing in fierce head-to-head battles of speed and skill. See the world's most popular trucks like Grave Digger®, El Toro Loco®, Sparkle Smash™ and more only at Monster Jam. Be loud, cheer hard and watch these Monster Jam trucks do the impossible. It's too fun to miss!
